definitions.gloss: tears of frustration; tears of vexation
definitions.explanation: Tears shed out of frustration or chagrin, for example after a narrow defeat, a failure one could have avoided, or unfair treatment one cannot answer.

examples.japanese: {悔|くや}し{涙|なみだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{負|ま}けて→負ける：01134_makeru⟧、{悔|くや}し{涙|なみだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらなかった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: We lost in the final, and I couldn't stop crying tears of frustration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧{悔|くや}し{涙|なみだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のんだ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ついに⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: The players who swallowed their bitter disappointment last year finally won the championship this year.

notes:
From ⟦{悔|くや}しい→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧ (frustrating, vexing) + ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧ (tears); the adjective drops its final い, as in ⟦{嬉|うれ}し{涙|なみだ}→嬉し涙：34045_ureshinamida⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悔|くや}し{涙|なみだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: to shed tears of frustration
- {悔|くや}し{涙|なみだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}れる→暮れる：31225_kureru⟧: to be in tears of frustration
- {悔|くや}し{涙|なみだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のむ: to swallow one's bitter disappointment (often after a defeat, without actually crying)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{嬉|うれ}し{涙|なみだ}→嬉し涙：34045_ureshinamida⟧: tears of joy, the opposite
- {悔|くや}し{泣|な}き: crying from frustration (the act of crying)
